purpose: Normaliseer de nieuwste materiële learnings uit de actieve Bedrijfsgeheugen-chat naar canonieke machineleesbare Brain-state zodat toekomstige agents ze via preflight hergebruiken en niet opnieuw uit conversatietekst reconstrueren.

learnings.rootCause: GitHub Actions trigger scope was narrowed while the linked Netlify provider still treated repository-root pull-request changes as site-impacting, causing unnecessary preview builds.
learnings.fix: For Deploy Preview context only, evaluate the exact cached-to-current Git diff and skip only when every changed path is explicitly governance-only. Production always builds because release identity is exact COMMIT_REF-bound. Unknown refs, missing diff evidence, unknown paths, site paths, Netlify configuration, functions and build-tool changes fail safe to BUILD.
evidence: PR #804 site/build-control candidate produced a real Netlify Deploy Preview on exact candidate SHA, proving the impact side still builds. Two-sided skip evidence is still required before PROVEN maturity.
learnings.openObligation: Obtain external provider evidence that a governance-only Deploy Preview diff is actually skipped; do not promote maturity to PROVEN before both BUILD and SKIP sides are evidenced.

learnings.rootCause: A regression-test family can be classified while its newly introduced runtime or provider-control inputs remain outside the BRAIN delivery lane taxonomy. This occurred with netlify.toml and tools/netlify-preview-impact.mjs.
learnings.fix: Co-classify runtime/control paths and their regression family in the owning delivery lanes. Netlify provider configuration belongs to website/Netlify delivery; Netlify governance/runtime impact tooling belongs to backend governance. All unknown remaining paths stay fail-closed.
evidence: Unified BRAIN rejected the candidate with: unclassified delivery path: netlify.toml, tools/netlify-preview-impact.mjs.

learnings.rootCause: A cost/impact guard can appear correct after proving only that an impact-bearing change still executes. That does not prove the optimization path actually skips non-impact work at the external provider.
learnings.fix: Require two-sided provider evidence before PROVEN status: a site/build-impact canary must BUILD and a proven governance-only canary must SKIP. Keep the guard at GUARDED or equivalent partial maturity until both are externally observed.
learnings.openObligation: Run and read back a governance-only Netlify Deploy Preview canary after the provider guard is merged.

learnings.rootCause: An open candidate was treated as reusable after main materially changed the same file or semantic contract required by the candidate implementation.
learnings.fix: Refresh live main before GREEN/final promotion. If file or semantic/declared-contract overlap exists, close or supersede the stale candidate and rebuild from exact current main. Preserve prior RED evidence but never carry stale implementation forward as current truth.
evidence: PR #831, #833 and #835 were superseded after same-file policy drift; successor candidates were rebuilt from exact current main rather than overwriting newer canonical learning links.

learnings.rootCause: Delivery membership/classification and the actual test executor evolved separately. tests/chat-to-brain-* was classified as backend work but the backend lane command did not execute that family, allowing a false-green run.
learnings.fix: Co-change classifier ownership and executor discovery. The canonical Brain test runner auto-discovers tests/chat-to-brain-*.test.mjs so every classified chat-to-Brain regression is executed by the backend and automation verification paths.
evidence: Before executor repair the classified lane completed without running the new test. After scripts/brain/test-all.mjs was extended, exact head ea2d5da3b6117a2993cff24c27674dc6783c826a ran it and produced the intended RED because the canonical materialization source was absent.

completionRule: This materialization is complete only after the source is mandatory in canonical chat-learning preflight, visible in compiled output, regression-tested, delivered through BRAIN gates and read back from main after merge.
